scope: General model/training/runtime co-design; no machine-specific diagnosis or setup.

sources.title: MLX framework design
sources.used_for: Shared memory, autodiff, lazy evaluation, CPU/GPU devices; distinguishes runtime from model architecture.

sources.title: MLX-LM DWQ implementation

sources.used_for: LoRA, DoRA and full fine-tuning, quantized-base LoRA, gradient-checkpointing tradeoff.

sources.used_for: Runtime quantization contract; supported layout/mode/group shape must be checked, not inferred from nominal bits.

sources.title: oMLX hybrid cache handling

sources.title: Updates to Apple’s On-Device and Server Foundation Language Models
sources.used_for: Published architecture/deployment examples: QAT, cross-layer KV sharing, PT-MoE, ASTC; not treated as public MLX conversion features.

sources.used_for: QAT/FP compute allocation; 86M–2.2B empirical range; no universal percentage extrapolated.

sources.used_for: Distinguishes approximately 47B total and 13B active parameters; not storage equivalent to dense 13B.

sources.used_for: Architecture/algorithm co-design; no Apple throughput claim.

derived_calculations.kv_formula: 2 * batch * sequence_length * attention_layers * kv_heads * head_dim * bytes_per_value
derived_calculations.assumptions: Uncompressed equal-dimensional key/value tensors, all listed layers full attention; excludes padding/metadata/other memory.
derived_calculations.cost_objective: Proposed normalized loss+latency+energy objective with hard memory and quality constraints; not a sourced or implemented MLX-LM feature.
derived_calculations.break_even: Training/validation cost divided by positive per-inference savings; illustrative accounting only.

validation.source_inspection: Selected methods, not exhaustive repository audit
validation.paper_scope: Published mechanisms and stated author results; no independent reproduction
